articles.title: How a Stranger's Airplane Drawings Gave a Young Woman 'Realistic Hope' Before Brain Surgery
articles.summary: At 20, Rebecca Simonitsch faced brain surgery for epilepsy. On her flight home from Johns Hopkins, a stranger — a neuropsychologist — drew diagrams of the procedure on graph paper. His compassion eased her anxiety. She's been seizure-free for 25 years.

articles.title: Trump Delays Spy Chief Confirmation, Demands Surveillance and Voter ID Laws
articles.summary: President Trump postponed Jay Clayton's confirmation as Director of National Intelligence, keeping acting chief Bill Pulte. He's pressuring Democrats to renew a controversial surveillance law and pass voter ID legislation. Senators call the move regrettable and chaotic.

articles.title: Arthur, Season's First Named Storm, Threatens Gulf Coast with 'Life-Threatening' Floods
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Arthur formed near Texas with 40 mph winds. The slow-moving system is expected to unleash up to 20 inches of rain, triggering flash flood warnings from Texas to Georgia. It's the earliest named storm since the average June 20 start.
